text_block_list.text: The "Undefeated Triple Crown"—

It refers not just to winning the Oka Sho, 
Yushun Himba, and Shuka Sho... but 
achieving complete and utter victory, 
including all prep races.

Mejiro Ramonu had also won the Fillies' 
Revue, Flora Stakes, and Rose Stakes, 
splendidly completing a truly perfect 
Triple Tiara.

"—With you, I'd even want to aim for an 
undefeated Triple Crown."

"—If it's with you, I want to aim for an 
undefeated Triple Crown."

When I signed the Trainer contract with 
her... the ideal I spoke aloud became 
reality.
choice_data_list:
(This great feat wouldn't have been 
possible without Ramonu.)

text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, it's a title 
you wouldn't need to chase. It inevitably 
means running consecutive races, draining 
her stamina... And yet, even so—

—Mejiro Ramonu was an Umamusume who 
pursued "perfection." That is why she 
sought... the true Triple Crown.

—I want to praise her. With that in mind, 
I went looking for her while she was 
resting right after the Shuka Sho, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why are you speaking to me so casually?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Who is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ... And so... Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: And who is this? Is she yours?

The nightmare of that day comes rushing 
back…… To think that after walking 
together this far, Mejiro Ramonu would 
forget me all over again……

Now I can proudly call myself her Trainer. 
If she forgets me, I'll just remind her as 
many times as it takes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How outrageous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Did you truly think I had forgotten all 
your many funny faces?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because you looked so genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I just remembered that day…… and decided 
to tease you a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you panic, you feel down... and 
you steel your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You don't believe me, do you?
choice_data_list: N-No, I didn't mean it like that...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. I'll forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "So, what brings you here?"
choice_data_list:
I wanted to celebrate your Undefeated 
Triple Crown!

I wanted to celebrate you achieving the 
perfect Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I was just, as always, simply perfect..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You are the one who sought it and made it 
happen. Should we not be praising you for 
guiding them instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I remember the color you showed that day 
very well indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Vermilion... from here on out, may your 
true colors shine even more beautifully.
